purpose: Extend reconstruction reproducibility beyond a single measured walnut to another physical object. These data do not contain certified dimensions or defect labels.
source_gate: Full size and publisher MD5 for all eight original ZIPs, exact metadata SHA-256 and acquisition fields. Read TIFFs without extracting untrusted names. Require precisely frames 1..721 with unique indices; omit duplicate angle 360 at 721. Log all 720 used TIFF SHA-256s and validate ZIP member CRCs.

acquisition.dataset: Alexander Meaney, Cone-Beam Computed Tomography Dataset of a Pine Cone, University of Helsinki, CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.6985407
acquisition.angles: start zero; 720 half-degree increments, same internal rotation convention as the walnut. No claim of validated specimen pose.
acquisition.preprocess: Inputs publisher flat/dark corrected. No walnut-specific five-pixel translation and no fit to ASTRA. Arithmetic intensity 8x8 bin, per-view mean of original top-left 128x128 air ROI, positive 0.5 floor before negative log; no clipping of negative log values. Reject nonfinite, zero air, changed shape.
acquisition.subsets: first full 720, independently replay 90 views at original indices 1,9,...,713 from the ZIPs and require exact bytes of full[::8].

reconstruction.references: On each of the 90-view and 720-view scans, two unchanged native CUDA runs (output byte identical) and an independently implemented ASTRA FDK on the same geometry, physical scale and unmodified intensities; max relative L2 0.002 each. Confirm finite nonconstant full volume, original budgets and guard regions. No cross-density equality requirement.
reconstruction.roi_requirement: Native directly reconstructed ROI equals dense native crop byte for byte at both locations, on both scans.

no_physical_claim: Cross-implementation agreement, same-grid ROI equality, and repeatability only; not a new ground truth for porosity, dimensions, dose response, or industrial inspection acceptance. Do not tune axis, window, registration, or gain to meet the limit. An unavailable download or failed gate stays incomplete.
